_comment: Schema for data/pulse-content-draft.json — written by the Phase 2 editorial agent (role 'editorial', e.g. claude_opus_4_8) inside Perplexity Computer. This is REVIEWABLE editorial copy ONLY. It carries the prose the agent proposes for the editable fields named in automation/editable-fields-map.md, plus provenance tying it to the exact task + findings. It NEVER carries signal data values (current_value, data_points, compared_to, percentile, sources, last_updated) — those are read-only and live only in pulse-content.json. The runner validates this on --draft-ingest and refuses to write an invalid draft. shadow_mode true = writing this publishes nothing.

fingerprint._comment: must equal the task + findings fingerprint

findings_id._comment: the research findings this draft is built from

editorial_date._comment: the date this editorial read is being made (today). Becomes last_editorial_reviewed + the WC dateline. Must be today on a real run.

throughline._comment: One sentence the agent commits to as the single voice/idea connecting the whole page this cycle. Used by the validator to judge cohesion. Not published directly.

signals._comment: One entry per IN-SCOPE signal the agent re-drafted. Only signals the task put in scope (or whose live copy the findings flagged at-risk) should appear. Each entry is editorial prose only.

status._comment: single status word/short phrase; drives the polarity gate. Pick honestly — choppy/mixed/steady map to flat (always aligned) when the data is genuinely noisy.

why_we_think_this._comment: OPTIONAL. The expandable 'how we measure this' methodology prose. Phase 3 made the PROSE subfields editable so the macro-editor can clear jargon and overlong sentences here. Carry ONLY these three prose fields; signals_used is a read-only machine list and is NEVER drafted (the apply step preserves it). Same hard rules apply: plain language, every number traceable, no advice. Present only when the editor rewrote this section.

weekly_connection._comment: Present only when the Weekly Connection was in scope (narrative_review_required or stale). Editable prose only — connected_signals are read-only and not carried here.

weekly_thought._comment: NEW in Phase 2 scope: the top hiring/AI headline + its 4 lens tabs. Present only when the Weekly Thought was in scope (stale or materially affected). lenses is keyed by the four fixed lens ids; each holds editable prose only.

page_prose._comment: Optional top-level page prose: the weekly_note summary and the pm_tension question/note. Present only when re-drafted.

self_assessment._comment: The editorial agent grades its OWN draft. Honest > optimistic. The deterministic gate and the independent validator do not trust this; it is recorded for review and to catch self-aware low confidence early.

one_voice_cohesion._comment: does the whole page read as one voice around the throughline?

numbers_traceable._comment: every number in the prose traces to real signal data or an allowlisted illustrative number
